newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BERLEI TO CLOSE AUSTRALIA'S LARGEST BRA FACTORY.
newsitem.headline: BERLEI TO CLOSE AUSTRALIA'S LARGEST BRA FACTORY.

text.p: Intimate apparel manufacturer Berlei said on Wednesday it was to close its Lithgow factory in New South Wales with the loss of 184 jobs.
Berlei said the factory was the largest bra manufacturer in Australia. Berlei manufactures about half the bras made in Australia, it said.
The company cited import competition and the high cost of local manufacturing as reasons for the closure.
"Despite the best efforts of all concerned, we cannot continue to absorb the higher costs of local manufacture," said Berlei general manager, Richard Glass.
Berlei said bra imports had increased three-fold in the last six years with imports now accounting for about 75 percent of the Australian market.
Berlei's manufacturing, design and cutting operations are to be consolidated at Rydalmere in Sydney.
